investigation: PSI-102, SAME (first flight): smoke of overheated spacecraft materials and of dibutyl phthalate, aged and measured
description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_same_w0.md, section 7.1: the SAME-R network without the temperature, no-flow and heating-time terms, with dibutyl phthalate. Material indicators are derived from material by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.

features.name: is_dbp
features.description: dibutyl phthalate (lamp wick is the reference)

features.name: inlet_velocity
features.description: nominal duct air speed during heating

features.name: net_aging_time
features.description: the horizon: age of the smoke when the row was measured

targets.name: d10
targets.description: count mean diameter M1/M0 at net_aging_time (lane-local)

targets.name: d30
targets.description: diameter of average mass at net_aging_time (lane-local)

targets.name: iss_full_scale
targets.description: ISS detector scatter channel at full scale, |V| >= 6.0 V
